text: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京主持澜沧江－湄公河合作第十一次外长会。王毅说，澜湄六国同饮一江水，命运紧相连。今年是澜湄合作首次领导人会议召开十周年。十年来，在六国领导人战略引领下，澜湄合作从搭框架、拓领域的建设期迈向强机制、重实效的深耕期，成为最具活力和潜力的区域合作“金色样板”。（央视）
text_en: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi chaired the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Beijing. Wang Yi said the six LMC countries share the same river and are closely bound by a shared future. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the first LMC Leaders' Meeting. Over the past decade, under the strategic guidance of the six countries' leaders, LMC has moved from a building phase of setting up frameworks and expanding areas to a deepening phase of strengthening mechanisms and focusing on practical results, becoming the most dynamic and promising "golden model" of regional cooperation. (CCTV)
